# Chart.js browser bundle

`chart.umd.min.js` is the unmodified UMD distribution from the [Chart.js 4.5.1 npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/chart.js/v/4.5.1). It matches the SHA-384 integrity value previously used for the CDN copy. The bundle includes `@kurkle/color` 0.3.2, as identified by the upstream source map.

The original MIT notices are in [chartjs-LICENSE.md](chartjs-LICENSE.md) and [kurkle-color-LICENSE.md](kurkle-color-LICENSE.md).
